blogTitle: Notes From The Front Office (and my kitchen)
about: Hello!! This is Debbie, Kayla's mom. I joined OurSpace to keep an eye on things and so far the things are: loud. I do not know how to turn off the music. It starts every time and I am at WORK. I run the attendance window at the high school, so yes I know who was tardy and no I will not say it on here (TONY). I HAVE TWO GIRLS, COURTNEY IS AT COLLEGE AND NEVER CALLS AND KAYLA IS RIGHT DOWN THE HALL AND ALSO NEVER CALLS. sorry, the caps lock was on. I make a King Ranch casserole that has ended arguments. If you are a friend of Kayla's you are welcome at my table, just take your shoes off at the door. Love, Mom
aboutMore: Things I have learned on here so far: 1) LOL does not mean lots of love. I signed a sympathy card that way in March and I would like to apologize to the Pruitt family. 2) A 'top 8' is a ranking of your friends and I am not on my own daughter's. I am fine. 3) If you type on a 'wall' everyone can see it, which Kayla has explained to me four times, most recently about the retainer. 4) Brittany is a lovely girl with very good manners. 5) There is a cat on this website and I believe I know him. Love, Mom
meet: Whoever is in charge of the volume. Also that Hayley girl from the Paramore band. Kayla plays her in the car and I looked up the words at work. That young lady has a set of lungs on her and I think she and I would get along. And Dr. Phil, so he can tell me if I should knock on Kayla's door or leave the plate outside it. Love, Mom

interests.Movies: Steel Magnolias, Sweet Home Alabama, My Big Fat Greek Wedding, Father of the Bride (both), The Notebook (Kayla and I watched it together ONE time and she will not admit she let me hold the tissue box)
interests.Television: American Idol, Extreme Makeover Home Edition (I cry every time. MOVE THAT BUS), Dr. Phil, Dancing With The Stars, Trading Spaces, the 10 o'clock weather
interests.Books: anything by Nicholas Sparks, The Purpose Driven Life (halfway), the Southern Living annual recipes, the Creative Memories catalog, the student handbook (I typed it)
interests.Heroes: my dad Walt (carried the mail 34 years, never took a sick day), my sister Linda (do not tell her), both my girls, Dr. Phil, the lady at Kohl's who lets me stack coupons

blog.title: I Listened To The Whole CD
blog.body: Kayla left a burned CD in the Suburban. It says DO NOT TOUCH in purple marker, which I took to mean 'not while I am in the car.' So Tuesday I drove to Curves and back the long way and listened to all 17 songs. Some observations. One, these young people are very upset, and they are upset in tune, which I respect. Two, there is a girl singer on track 4 who I would put up against anybody at my church. Three, track 9 is the drummer's band. You can tell because it was recorded in a garage and somebody's dad says 'that's enough' at the end. I sat in the driveway until it finished. I don't understand all of it. But I understood more about my daughter in 58 minutes than I have since she got her own phone line. I put the CD back exactly where it was. If you tell her, I will deny it. Love, Mom

blog.title: Things I Have Typed In The Wrong Box (A List)
blog.body: I am told the box at the top is a 'status,' the box on someone's page is a 'wall,' and the box with the envelope is private. I have been using them as one box. So here is a list of things the whole website now knows. 1. Kayla's retainer lives next to the bananas. 2. My husband's cholesterol number. (It is better now. Thank you to the four of you who asked.) 3. That I think the Hendersons' new fence is over the property line. This is a different Henderson than the science teacher. I think. 4. My grocery list from the 6th. A boy named Randy commented 'PIE' and he was right, I had forgotten the pie crust. 5. A note to my sister that began 'Linda, between us.' It was not between us. It was between about forty people and a cat. I am learning. Slowly. Love, Mom

blog.title: Sunday At Dad's
blog.body: Took Dad his casserole. He had the computer on, the one Kayla set up for him on Mother's old sewing table, and he was typing with two fingers and his reading glasses pushed up on his head. I asked who he was writing to. He said, 'A young man named Patrick who has a rock.' I asked what they write about. He said, 'Tomatoes, mostly. He asks good questions.' Dad carried the mail for 34 years and I don't think he ever got much of it himself. Now he gets three or four letters a day from a boy with a rock, and he answers every single one, Dear and Regards and all. I ran the vacuum. The cat looked at me like I had keyed his car. Dad walked me out to the driveway and said to tell Kayla her 'electric mail' works fine. I am not going to correct him. Love, Mom

survey.title: FW: Getting To Know You!! (from Linda. I am supposed to send it to 10 people)
qa: Name?
Debbie. Deborah Jean on my driver's license and when I am in trouble with my father.
What time did you get up this morning?
5:15. Lunches don't pack themselves and neither does my husband.
Last thing you ate?
The crusts off Kayla's toast, standing at the sink, like every mother in America.
Favorite smell?
The laminator when it is warming up. Also bread.
What is on your mouse pad?
A picture of both girls at Six Flags. Courtney is squinting and Kayla is mad about a hat.
Coke or Pepsi?
Diet Dr Pepper and I will not be taking questions.
Do you sing in the car?
I do now. It's the Paramore. Do not tell Kayla.
What did you want to be when you grew up?
A flight attendant. Then a mom. I got the one with fewer pretzels.
Who is most likely to respond to this?
Linda, within four minutes, with an angel.
Who is least likely to respond?
Courtney. She's at college. She's very busy. She's fine. I'm fine.
Hugs or kisses?
Hugs, and you will take one whether you want it or not.
What are you listening to right now?
Rascal Flatts. Against my will. Love, Mom
